Compose the secure daemon API host

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-56
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - add strict disabled-by-default API configuration with bounded limits, compiled version validation, loopback/TLS-terminated deployment modes, explicit lifecycle policy, exact origins, and environment-only credentials
    - derive constant-time Bearer identities into bounded Actor, Profile, and scope request context while enforcing command headers, CORS, request IDs, security headers, deadlines, concurrency, and body/result limits
    - bind the sealed codeon-api foundation on a separate listener with loaded Profile and PostgreSQL query services, readiness gating, observable failure isolation, and bounded daemon shutdown
    - preserve disabled-mode and MCP behavior while adding focused configuration, authentication, listener, limit, and lifecycle coverage
    
    ## Verification
    
    - cargo test -p codeon --test config
    - cargo test -p codeon --lib daemon::api::tests
    - cargo test -p codeon --lib daemon::runtime::tests
    - cargo test -p codeon --test mcp_security
    - cargo clippy -p codeon --all-targets -- -D warnings
